AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
November 10, 2021
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.
Commissioner Martinez will participate via teleconference and will be located at Harvard Kennedy School located at 79 John F. Kennedy Street Cambridge, MA 02138 for the duration of the meeting.

Case No.: UP-2021-03 Location: 470 S. Mira Loma Ave., #A, Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8615-016-007
Applicant: Hong Mao (Junan Truck Driving School)
The City of Azusa received a Use Permit application for a commercial truck driving school which is classified as a specialized training school. The proposal also includes the demolition of five existing buildings and various site improvements such as landscaping, parking stall re-striping and a new trash enclosure.
This project is categorically exempt from environmental review per Class 01 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301) and Class 03, Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15303), (California Environmental Quality Act).
This item was originally scheduled for the October 27, 2021 Planning Commission meeting but was continued to the November 10, 2021 meeting.
